item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 05/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Upper-air disturbances will bring showers to Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region.
